EmailTemplate.subject: Exciting Offers for your Donors!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Your blood drive is coming up, and every donation is vital because hospital patients are counting on lifesaving blood products from your drive. We are grateful for your kindness and commitment to helping those in need.
Team Red Cross needs more players, and we’re looking to fill the roster with volunteers like you! Join me at my blood drive and help keep the blood supply at a safe level!
When donors come to give May 20-31, they'll receive an exclusive Red Cross beach towel, while they last!^ PLUS, get a chance to win a 4-night trip for 2 to the 2023 MLB All-Star Game in Seattle! Includes flights, hotel, $750 gift card & more.^^
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
IMPORTANT: Donors MUST have a valid email address on file to receive their reward.
All the best,
{!Lead.OwnerFirstName}
P.S. Each Red Cross blood drive and donation center follows a high standard of safety and infection control to protect our partners, donors and staff.
^^Void where prohibited. Open to legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, age 18+ (19+ in NE and AL; 21+ in MS) at entry. Begins 12:00 a.m. ET on 05/01/23; ends 11:59 p.m. ET on 05/31/23. No purchase or donation necessary. To enter, either present to donate blood at an American Red Cross blood donation facility or send an email to customercare@redcross.org to enter free of charge and include the Giveaway name, “American Red Cross 2023 All-Star Weekend Giveaway.” One (1) winner will receive a trip for two (2) to the 2023 MLB® All-Star Game® in Seattle, Washington. Total ARV of all prizes: $7,000 US. Odds of winning depend on number of entries received. Full Official Rules click here. Sponsor: American Red Cross.
